function.description: Read your typed preferences and settings (read-only here). operation='list' shows every preference (value/source/applies); 'get' with `key` shows one; 'explain' with `key` shows the provenance chain of ANY setting (preference or env flag) — use it to answer 'why is X off?'; 'search' (`query`) finds a setting; 'changed' lists those off their default; 'check' names broken env or preference lines. A change is the owner's: propose_setting.
function.name: preferences

key.description: Setting key (e.g. 'style.verbosity'); explain also takes an env flag (e.g. 'TWITTER_ENABLED')
